work.objective: Reproduce the proven reconciler-safe 80x24 help overlay and raw-Escape implementation, then independently verify it with a correctly structured multiline Expect PTY gate.
constraints: Use repository-relative paths for all operations.
Only modify the four allowlisted help files; no Ink, dependency, lockfile, Marshal-state, commit, push, publication, network or subagent changes.

Reproduce the R5 semantics from the frozen requirements without reading prior run artifacts or worktrees: supported string/span TextNodeRenderable children, 80x24 bounded rows/footer, and useLayoutEffect registration/cleanup of a plain-Escape-only renderer input handler.
Use only supported string/span children in TextNodeRenderable and keep footer/hints visible at 80x24.
Use renderer addInputHandler/removeInputHandler while the overlay is active to consume only plain raw Escape and invoke onClose once; do not consume Ctrl+C or unrelated sequences.
Worker checks may use OpenTUI vitest, CLI typecheck/build and git diff --check only; native Bun/PTY belongs to verifier.
If denied, do not retry the denied path; use an allowed equivalent or report blocked.
context: Direct Bun probes established that raw Escape reaches the overlay addInputHandler, closes the dialog, and Ctrl+C then exits.
The prior verification was a false negative because its braced Expect pattern/action clauses were written on one physical line.
Verifier requires ready → /help → footer → raw Esc → newly visible composer → Ctrl+C EOF with each Expect branch on its own line.
